scope_branches: Parking beside a red-painted curb, subject to the complete subsection.
source_law_text: The parking of vehicles is prohibited or restricted in certain zones as set forth in this Section. The location of such zones shall be established by posting appropriate signage or other durable markings, by painting curbs or the edges of road surfaces in accordance with the colors listed below, or by a combination thereof: Red indicates no stopping, standing or parking, whether or not the vehicle is attended and whether or not the engine or motor is running, subject to the following: (1) Except as provided in this Subsection, a curb or road surface edge which is painted red indicates no parking, whether or not accompanied by signage to that effect. (2) When the location is accompanied by signage which indicates that parking is limited to tour buses, shuttle buses and limos, those vehicles may park for a period up to thirty minutes for the loading or unloading of passengers. (3) When the location is accompanied by signage which indicates that parking is limited to RTC buses, those vehicles may park for a period up to thirty minutes for the loading or unloading of passengers. (4) Armored cars and emergency vehicles may park at such locations for the period necessary to conduct their business, whether or not there is accompanying signage so indicating. (5) At locations where a drop box for U.S. mail is adjacent to a curb or road surface painted red, a person may stop for the period of time necessary to expeditiously deposit mail in such a drop box.
